contracts: AssistantTurnArtifacts.raw_content (str) is the only textual input allowed to reach tool-call parsing (Chief Architect Ruling #2).
AssistantTurnArtifacts.clean_content (str) is the only assistant text allowed to reach transcript persistence.
SanitizedOutput = NewType('SanitizedOutput', str) is the post-sanitization type used for user-visible output (public/transcript_ir.py, per Chief Architect Ruling #2).
ParsedToolPlan and TranscriptAppendRequest are explicit dataclasses in public/transcript_ir.py (Chief Architect Ruling #2).
transcript_ir.py is public (roles.kernel.public.transcript_ir), not internal; external consumers must import from the public path (Chief Architect Ruling #3).
native_tool_calls remain the primary structured stream source; raw_content is the textual fallback.
Older resumed dialogue must be compacted into continuity summaries; raw history cannot be injected twice through both history and context_override.

FactoryRoleEvidenceCutoffAckV1 is locator-only; FactoryRoleEvidenceCutoffPort.resolve_cutoff_proof must strictly re-read committed authority facts and return an exact FactoryRoleEvidenceCutoffProofV1.
FactoryRoleEvidenceCutoffSourceHeadV1 and FactoryRoleEvidenceCutoffProofV1 are detached proof DTOs; runtime authority ports never enter provider requests, snapshots, events, or metadata assets.

FactoryRoleSemanticRequestIdentityV1, FactoryRoleSemanticCandidateV1, and FactoryRoleFrozenSemanticRequestV1 are immutable result/value DTOs exported by the public cutoff module; they are not commands or queries.
B3.2 freezes the semantic request after canonical provider-visible evidence injection and stops before physical provider dispatch.
B3.3-B3.5 remain required for every role, retry, fallback, structured, stream, and Director fanout physical provider attempt.

residual_risks: raw_content remains string-backed by design, but execution parser entrypoints now require AssistantRawContent and structural tests fence compatibility wrappers from authorization paths.
internal/transcript_ir.py is now a compatibility re-export shim; new code must import from public/transcript_ir.py to be compliant with Chief Architect Ruling #3.
Session continuity packs still use deterministic heuristics today; future tuning must preserve the single continuity-memory data model instead of adding a second memory path.

B3.3-B3.5 have not yet proven one independent qualification and readable final provider-request snapshot for every role, retry, fallback, structured, stream, and Director fanout physical attempt; Provider and Bench remain unauthorized.
